intro: Report to Orgnil is an early Horde quest dispatched by Master Gadrin from Sen'jin Village. It directs fledgling adventurers northward to Razor Hill to warn Orgnil Soulscar about the insidious reach of the Burning Blade cult. This dispatch helps coordinate Durotar's scattered defense against demonic corruption brewing right in the orcs' homeland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid. But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade! Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials. He will want to know these things.
Razor Hill lies to the north.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes? You have something to report? Well then, let's have it!
